gloss: front and back, before and after

definitions.gloss: front and back, before and behind
definitions.explanation: The area or direction in front and behind something. Spatial orientation.
The time immediately before and after an event. Also used to indicate approximate time.
The surrounding context or circumstances of a situation.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:

1. SPATIAL (front/back):
- {前後|ぜんご}⟦{左右|さゆう}→左右：02826_sayuu⟧ (front, back, left, right - all directions)
- {前後|ぜんご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (to look front and back)

2. TEMPORAL (around a time):
- ⟦{3時|さんじ}→三時：10983_sanji⟧{前後|ぜんご} (around 3 o'clock)
- ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{前後|ぜんご} (around the time of the incident)

3. CONTEXTUAL:
- {前後|ぜんご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文脈|ぶんみゃく}→文脈：12723_bunmyaku⟧ (surrounding context)
- ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{前後|ぜんご} (the context of the story)

EXPRESSION: {前後|ぜんご}⟦{不覚|ふかく}→不覚：14884_fukaku⟧ = losing consciousness, being in a daze
